insights.title: 41 bars with an impossible price: close outside the high-low range
insights.detail: These bars were excluded from daily bars and VWAP, but remain listed in the quality report.
insights.suggestedRule: Require low <= close <= high on every bar.

insights.title: 2 bars with an impossible price: open outside the high-low range
insights.detail: These bars were excluded from daily bars and VWAP, but remain listed in the quality report.
insights.suggestedRule: Require low <= open <= high on every bar.

insights.title: 9,821 unusually large price moves
insights.detail: 53% of them happen right after a data gap, so the price "jump" is mostly catching up on missing bars rather than a bad tick.
insights.suggestedRule: Fix the gaps first; measure price moves only between consecutive bars when testing for spikes.

insights.title: SR3M26: 46,339 gaps spread across the trading day
insights.detail: No hour holds more than 7% of the gaps. That pattern fits thin trading - minutes where no trades happened - rather than a feed outage.
insights.suggestedRule: Treat quiet minutes as expected for SR3M26: raise its gap threshold, or carry the last price forward for analytics instead of alerting.
